messages:
sam_w: FYI customer (pool-id: pool-7f9a) is seeing a bunch of reserved GPU hours charged overnight, but their token burn stayed flat. customer says burst_hours jumped ~120 in a 2h window.

jess_li: ugh. do we have the invoice id / timeframe? any customer repro steps?

sam_w: invoice INV-2026-07-19-ACME, window 2026-07-18T22:00Z -> 2026-07-19T02:00Z. customer noticed app-level qps was the same. they supplied this small excerpt from their logs: 
```
[2026-07-18T22:37:02Z] request id=abc123 model=redwood-13b pool=pool-7f9a tokens_in=12 tokens_out=34
[2026-07-18T22:37:05Z] request id=abc124 model=redwood-13b tokens_in=8 tokens_out=16
```
so no obvious spike. billing UI shows reserved_hours_consumed increase + burst_hours +120.

priya_r: can we rule out clock skew between the serving nodes and billing aggregator? last time we saw weird bursts it was a collector replay.

henry_k: good call. @ops_oncall can you check NTP / chrony status on the pool nodes and the billing collector host for that window? also check the exporter restart logs.

ops_oncall: looking. I pulled node metrics for pool-7f9a. Chrony ntp offset on two gpus was ~3500s at 2026-07-18T22:40Z (yikes). exporter (metrics-collector-3) restarted repeatedly around 22:39 due to OOM, then came back and re-ingested. grabbing traces now.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-07-19-ACME processed. Provisional credits may be applied pending investigation. See /billing/invoices/INV-2026-07-19-ACME

jess_li: that offset explains it — if the collector re-ingested older samples after clock fix, aggregator could double-count wall-time based hours. Priya, can you confirm if our dedupe window would prevent that?

priya_r: our dedupe is based on (node_id, sample_ts) and we tolerate 30s jitter. With >1h offsets, replayed samples look new. we should have a replay protection for exporter restarts but not implemented yet. for now we need to reconcile the hours and issue credits.

henry_k: steps: 1) run SQL on billing_events for pool-7f9a for that 4h window to get raw samples; 2) pull prometheus scrape timestamps for nodes; 3) compare distinct sample_ts count vs wall-clock uptime. I'm pasting an ad-hoc query — run from analytics: 
```
SELECT sample_ts, node_id, COUNT(*) as samples
FROM billing_samples
WHERE pool_id='pool-7f9a' AND sample_ts >= '2026-07-18T22:00:00Z' AND sample_ts <= '2026-07-19T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY sample_ts, node_id
ORDER BY sample_ts;
```

sam_w: ran that and attaching clipped output (trimmed):
```
2026-07-18T22:00:00Z node-4 1
2026-07-18T22:00:01Z node-4 1
... (normal cadence) ...
2026-07-18T22:39:00Z node-4 1
2026-07-18T21:39:00Z node-4 1   <-- older-timestamp samples showing up after restart
2026-07-18T21:39:01Z node-4 1
... repeated backward-hour samples until 22:42:00Z
```

jess_li: that matches replayed sample hypothesis. we should mark those samples as replayed and exclude from billing aggregation. Priya / Henry can you confirm the exact dedupe / correction to apply so i can tell the customer estimated credits?

priya_r: plan: 1) identify samples where sample_ts < collector_restart_time but were ingested after restart (we have ingestion_time column). 2) tag those as replay=true and subtract equivalent reserved_seconds from billing aggregation for pool-7f9a in that window. 3) generate a corrected usage report for the invoice. I'll prepare the SQL to flag them.

henry_k: SQL I'll run (analytics role):
```
UPDATE billing_samples
SET replay=true
WHERE pool_id='pool-7f9a'
  AND ingestion_time >= '2026-07-18T22:39:00Z'
  AND sample_ts < '2026-07-18T22:39:00Z';
```

henry_k: then run aggregation job with --dry-run to compute delta.

ops_oncall: node fleet fix: I pushed a hotpatch to exporter to guard OOM and bumped cron to ensure NTP restart on reboot. also added alert when ntp offset >60s.

sam_w: customer asked for ETA on credits and wants to know whether to disable burst autoscale until fix. recommendation?

jess_li: tell them they can temporarily lower burst ceiling for that pool (via console -> pool -> burst_limit) — that prevents surprise cost while we finalize credits. include steps to revert.

priya_r: ETA: I will run the flagging and aggregation dry-run now, should have numbers in ~30m. if delta negative we'll request provisional credit ASAP.

sam_w: thanks. I'll message customer with conservative guidance and link to the console setting. will update when you post numbers. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Credit request created: CR-2026-07-19-001 (pending manual approval).

jess_li: nice. follow-up action item: engineering to add replay protection and longer dedupe window for billing_samples. filing a tracking ticket in eng-infra.

sam_w: closing loop for now — will reopen if anything else pops up.
